When RDA DB 10.4 has no row linked to a species, a reviewed MEXT item marked species_row is that species' own nutrition row and edible fraction (graded foreign_table_cited 0.85, ranked against the fixed cohort plus itself, never a cohort member): あげまき 10280 (맛조개), まさば 10154 (고등어), まだこ 10361 (참문어). Name link: the MEXT standard Japanese name equals the WoRMS Japanese vernacular, or equals it without a final ガイ (貝) when the MEXT description matches the taxon. Three aquaculture records (research/verified-indices/mfpi-aquaculture-3.9-2026-10-01.json): 고등어 Tongyeong sea cages 2007-08, 맛조개 Zhoushan polyculture pond 2020-21, 참문어 rearing stopped at settlement (feasible false). grade_notes.domestic_table: RDA row with a domestic source label such as ('16); per-value analysed/calculated status is not exposed online, so the row is not labelled 'measured'.
grade_notes.foreign_table_cited: RDA row whose source label names another national table, e.g. JAPAN('20) or USDA('18): same food, borrowed value. Pilot factor 0.85, same as 'calculated'.
grade_notes.measured/calculated/proxy: Kept from verified-pilot-1 for the AFCD cross-check rows.

primary_cohorts.criteria: RDA National Standard Food Composition DB 10.4, group '어패류 및 기타 수산물', raw ('생것') rows with protein, iron, zinc and calcium all reported per 100 g edible portion. Excludes organ/part-only rows, sex/region sub-sample rows and freshwater-farmed fish. Reference foods are not operating candidates.

exclude_food_item_ids.K0150002550a: 고등어 남해: regional sub-sample of one species
exclude_food_item_ids.K0150002560a: 고등어 서해: regional sub-sample of one species
exclude_food_item_ids.K0440002570a: 대구 수컷: sex sub-sample of one species
exclude_food_item_ids.K0440002580a: 대구 암컷: sex sub-sample of one species
exclude_food_item_ids.K1440010000a: 은어 양식: freshwater-farmed (amphidromous) fish, outside the marine scope

uncertainty: The cohort mixes molluscs, fish, crustaceans and a tunicate; ranks compare foods, not ecological or taxonomic peers.
Rows come from different source years and tables (domestic ('16), JAPAN('20), USDA('18)); per-value analysis method is not exposed.
Zinc is missing for most RDA seafood rows, so only foods reporting all three components can be ranked.

primary_cohorts.criteria: RDA DB 10.4, group '해조류', raw rows with protein, iron, zinc and calcium all reported per 100 g edible portion. Dried, salted and blanched rows are excluded by the raw-only rule and never converted.
uncertainty: Only three raw seaweed rows report all three components; each rank step moves a percentile by about 33 points.

substitutes.rule: Only a component missing from the species' own linked RDA row is filled, and only when that row reports at least one component. Candidates are uFiSh raw items of the consumed part fillet, flesh or muscle (not whole animal, organ or roe), per 100 g edible portion. Order: same-species RDA sub-sample rows (subsample_rule), then uFiSh WoRMS species or synonym, then same genus, then same family; within a level the higher grade factor, then larger n, then the lower item ID. A species-level value takes its grade from the uFiSh documentation code (a = measured 1.0; c, r, ar = calculated 0.85; e = proxy 0.5); every genus or family value is a proxy (0.5). Pooled entries spanning several families are never used.
substitutes.cohort_rule: The fixed cohorts stay the RDA rows that report all three components (frozen lists unchanged in 3.3). A species with a substituted component is ranked against the cohort plus itself, as a cohort member is, and never joins the cohort, so no other species' rank moves.
substitutes.not_used: AFCD Release 3 (FSANZ) food details carry no scientific names, so no AFCD row is matched to a genus or family; AFCD stays the oyster cross-check cohort.

subsample_links.link_evidence: RDA '대구, 수컷, 생것' / 'Pacific cod, Male, Raw': the same species as the linked row K0440000000a 'Pacific cod, Raw' (Gadus macrocephalus); the marine-animal cohort rule excludes it as a sex sub-sample of one species.

RDA '대구, 암컷, 생것' / 'Pacific cod, Female, Raw': the same species as the linked row K0440000000a 'Pacific cod, Raw' (Gadus macrocephalus); the marine-animal cohort rule excludes it as a sex sub-sample of one species.

substitutes.subsample_rule: Before any uFiSh value, a missing component is taken from other rows of the same RDA table that a review links to the same species and that the cohort rule excludes as sex or regional sub-samples (they never join the cohort). Several such rows give their arithmetic mean (equal weights; n is not published). The value keeps the rows' grade (domestic_table 1.0 or foreign_table_cited 0.85). Rows whose main row is not species-specific (e.g. 고등어 남해/서해 under the generic 고등어 row) are not linked.
substitutes.grade_note: A species-level uFiSh value keeps its documentation-code grade (a = measured 1.0). uFiSh documents each value's derivation (code, n, reference), whereas an RDA row citing another table does not expose it (0.85). The decision record shows the MFPI with other-table species values at 0.85 as a sensitivity.

mext.rule: A reviewed MEXT item is used only for the AphiaID it is linked to, only for a component listed here; as a substitute only when the species' own RDA row is blank for it and no RDA sub-sample or uFiSh species-level value exists, and only for a raw item per 100 g edible portion with a printed analytical or calculated value (estimates in parentheses, Tr and '-' are never used). It ranks above any genus or family proxy. 3.9: an item marked species_row is the species' own nutrition row (all listed components and the refuse share) only when RDA DB 10.4 has no row linked to the species; it is ranked against the fixed cohort of its RDA group plus itself and never joins the cohort.
mext.link_rule: The MEXT standard Japanese name (food name, or the name the chapter 3 notes give) equals the Japanese vernacular WoRMS lists for the AphiaID, or equals it without a final ガイ (貝) when the chapter 3 description (family, form, habitat) matches the taxon. Generic names (なまこ, かき) are never linked to one species.

nutrition.minimum_components_rule: A species row outside the cohort is scored when at least this many components are reported (own value or substitute). Missing components are left out of the mean and never scored 0; the trace lists them as omitted_components.
nutrition.cross_check_note: verified-pilot-3.7: the AFCD Release 3 oyster cross-check (verified-pilot-1 cohort) is paused because its rows carry no reviewed calcium value; 3.6 and earlier keep it.

conservation.label: IUCN 기반 시범 MCUI, OBIS 출현 추세(조사 노력 보정) 보조 반영

trend.effort: target group: OBIS records of the species' WoRMS class in the same cell and period; all-taxa records are a sensitivity
trend.cells: 1-degree cells where the species has a record in either period and its class has records in both periods
trend.formula: ratio = ((n_recent + 0.5) / E_recent) / ((n_past + 0.5) / E_past); 95% interval = ratio x/÷ exp(1.96 x sqrt(1/(n_past+0.5) + 1/(n_recent+0.5)))
trend.cell_rule: A record on a cell edge counts in every cell whose closed polygon holds it, as the OBIS statistics endpoint counts the effort; numerator and denominator use the same cells.
trend.dataset_check: A decline signal must also hold inside the dataset with most past records of the species (species and class records of that dataset only, same cells rule, same thresholds). Otherwise the fall may be a survey programme ending, and the class is undetermined. This is the reviewed-trend condition of docs/verified-indices-design.md, applied by rule to every species.
classes: undetermined: no comparable cell, fewer than min_past_records past records, a fall to ratio <= decline_ratio whose interval reaches 1, or a decline not confirmed within the dominant dataset
decline_signal: ratio <= decline_ratio (a 30% fall, IUCN criterion A2 VU threshold), interval below 1, and the same within the dominant dataset
decline_below_threshold: interval below 1 but the fall smaller than the threshold
survey_gap: fewer species records while class effort in the same cells also fell, and the reporting rate is not clearly lower
no_clear_decline: a reporting rate not lower
trend.mcui_rule: A decline signal adds effort_adjustment (10) to a computed MCUI, capped at 100. Other classes add nothing. No class creates an MCUI for a species without an IUCN or national category, and none lowers one.

no_assessment.rule: A species without a reviewed national category gets no MCUI and is labelled priority_survey when the IUCN search found no assessment (not_in_red_list -> no_conservation_assessment) or the assessment has no numeric category (DD -> conservation_data_deficient), beside the information-sufficiency reason. A failed lookup or an assessment not confirmed current is a data problem and does not add this reason.

national_fact_rule: A reviewed national red-list category (NIBR 2024, Republic of Korea scope) is shown next to the IUCN global assessment as a fact. It never becomes MCUI; national and global scopes stay separate.

posthoc.calibration_note: No weight or formula was tuned in verified-pilot-2, so no case was used for calibration.

MBPI.criterion: Origin species of a marine-derived drug at or beyond clinical stage should rank above operating candidates.
MBPI.reason: No origin -> compound -> assay chain was collected for these species in this snapshot and no operating candidate has an MBPI, so there is nothing to rank against.

MCUI.criterion: Among candidates, a species whose current IUCN assessment cites fishing and uses criterion A (population reduction) should rank above one assessed without a reduction criterion.
MCUI.reason: A. japonicus (EN A2bd, fishing) 80 > T. pacificus (LC, needs updating) 10. Only two species have an MCUI, so this is a consistency check, not validation.

national_red_list.label: 한국 국가 평가 기반 시범 MCUI
national_red_list.accepted_basis: IUCN Red List Categories and Criteria, regional-level guidelines
national_red_list.legal_protection: A legal protection designation without a red-list category is shown as a fact and never scored.
national_red_list.taxon_rule: Only rows whose published name resolves to the same accepted WoRMS species; subspecies and separate species are not moved.
national_red_list.ranking_rule: Never ranked, pooled or plotted with IUCN-based MCUI; national and global scopes stay separate.

page_recheck.method: NIBR e-catalogue page images re-read for the list page and the index page of every scored row (viewer page = printed page + 2)

peptide_bioactivity.minimum_justification: 30 peers keep one rank step at about 3 percentile points; below that a single peer moves the score more than the 0.75 single-DOI discount.
peptide_bioactivity.value_scale: pIC50 = 6 - log10(IC50 in uM); higher is more potent
peptide_bioactivity.note: Peptides never enter the small-molecule (ChEMBL) strata; the same single/multiple DOI factors and max aggregation apply.

cross_origin_potency.gap_justification: Team research assumption: a tenfold IC50 difference is the usual spread between labs for the same HHL assay; larger gaps are treated as non-replication, not averaged.
cross_origin_potency.rule: Potency replication only: the origin claim (sequence found in the species' own material) still needs the species' paper.

reference_combination.label: 참고 통합값 · 독립 재현 미확인
reference_combination.rule: Only when MFPI and MBPI are both calculated and BBVI is withheld because the MBPI rests on fewer independent papers than bbvi.minimum_independent_mbpi_dois. Never computed from a single axis, never written to scores.BBVI, never placed in the matrix or any ranking.
limits: MBPI는 독립 논문 재현이 확인되지 않았습니다.
MFPI와 MBPI의 비교집단(cohort)이 서로 다르며, 두 값은 각자의 집단 안 상대 위치입니다.
가중치 w는 팀 시범 규칙이며 민감도 결과를 함께 봐야 합니다.

chembl_bioactivity.label: 이 종에서 보고된 화합물의 공개 생리활성(잠재력) · 종 추출물의 효능 아님
chembl_bioactivity.review_rule: Every species -> compound link behind a primary ChEMBL item was checked against the linked paper titles, abstracts and the PubChem structure (mbpi-link-review-2026-09-30.json). A link is rejected only on positive evidence of one class: structure_mismatch (the name resolved to another structure), contaminant (pollutant or reagent found in the sample), not_tissue (found in faeces, diet or symbionts, not the organism), ubiquitous_metabolite (C1 metabolites, amino-acid amines, common C16-C22 fatty acids, C6-C10 oxidation aldehydes). A rejected link enters no item in any view. Each review entry stores the link's DOI set; the build stops when the DOIs differ (stale review) or when a primary item rests on a link without a review entry.
chembl_bioactivity.no_link_status: 정보충분도 낮음: no Wikidata P703 link and no accepted original-paper link after the CMNPD, PubChem taxonomy and Europe PMC search.
chembl_bioactivity.link_rule: Species -> compound: a Wikidata P703 (found in taxon) statement on the WoRMS accepted name or a WoRMS synonym with at least one P248 reference that has a DOI, or a verified original-paper link (paper_links) for species without P703 statements. References without a DOI are kept in the snapshot but do not count.
chembl_bioactivity.commonness_rule: Exclude a compound when its count of taxa with a P703 statement exceeds the Tukey upper fence Q3 + 1.5 IQR of the counts over every linked compound (statistics.quantiles, n=4, inclusive). Such compounds (fatty acids, amino acids, sterols, carotenoids) say nothing specific about one species. Sensitivity: the same fence on log10 counts, and no filter.
chembl_bioactivity.drug_rule: Exclude compounds whose ChEMBL parent is an approved drug (max_phase 4): LOTUS text mining attaches reference drugs used as assay controls to the paper's organism (zidovudine -> Ecklonia cava, DOI 10.1016/j.bmc.2008.07.078). Natural products that are also approved drugs lose their link too. Sensitivity: no filter.
chembl_bioactivity.cohort_rule: Cohort = every admitted ChEMBL activity with the same target_chembl_id and standard_type (activity level, counted with the ChEMBL API at the snapshot date). Species value = median pChEMBL of the parent compound's admitted activities in that cohort; percentile = 100 x (count below + 0.5 x count equal) / total.
chembl_bioactivity.minimum_justification: Same as the peptide stratum: 30 peers keep one rank step at about 3 percentile points; below that a single record moves the score more than the 0.75 single-DOI discount.
chembl_bioactivity.evidence_rule: link factor = 0.75 for one link DOI, 1.0 for two or more; activity factor = 0.75 for one ChEMBL document, 1.0 for two or more; evidence factor = link x activity. One item per species, parent compound and stratum: that compound's target x endpoint cohort with the highest percentile (ties: more records). The species MBPI is the highest adjusted item.
chembl_bioactivity.bbvi_rule: bbvi.minimum_independent_mbpi_dois applies as min(link DOIs, ChEMBL documents) >= 2, so both the species link and the activity rest on two papers each.
chembl_bioactivity.evidence_level: Reviewed original-paper strata (감태 ACE, AHTPDB peptides) are level 1; this automated stratum is level 2. The species MBPI is the max over all strata; the stratum of the best item is shown.

pathogen.label: 병원체(항균·항바이러스·항기생충)
pathogen.organism_class_note: ChEMBL organism classification (l1, l2). Bacteria, viruses and protozoan/helminth parasites only; fungi, oomycetes, arthropods, plants and vertebrates (for example Homo sapiens ORGANISM targets) are not pathogen targets here.

unexplored_candidates.rule: Information sufficiency below unexplored_threshold (mean ratio of required inputs) marks the species 'priority_survey' (우선 조사 대상). Such a species is an unexplored candidate (미탐색 후보) when a relative in the same WoRMS genus, else family, has a published BBVI of at least relative_min_bbvi (the matrix threshold). The relative's score is never copied.
unexplored_candidates.national_mcui_sufficiency: When mcui_basis is national, the MCUI steps are read from the national assessment that gives the MCUI: assessment_record = the reviewed national record, numeric_category = its category is in conservation.category_scores, current_check = its list and index pages were re-read (national_red_list.page_recheck). Otherwise the IUCN steps apply.
unexplored_candidates.weight_note: Relatives are judged at the published default BBVI weight (w = 0.5); the screen slider does not move this flag.

source.title: WoRMS AphiaClassificationByAphiaID (genus and family of the 30 species)
source.provider: WoRMS Editorial Board, World Register of Marine Species (VLIZ)
source.terms: Text open access under CC BY; cite WoRMS Editorial Board (2026). World Register of Marine Species. Available from https://www.marinespecies.org at VLIZ. doi:10.14284/170. Re-distribution of the entire database is not permitted; only genus and family of the 30 species are stored.

matrix.threshold_rule: A value at or above the threshold is high. BBVI is compared as published, rounded to one decimal (the screen's BBVI at the current weight is rounded the same way); MCUI category scores are whole numbers.
matrix.bbvi_weight: default_food_weight; the screen recomputes with its slider
matrix.national_mcui_note: A national red-list MCUI is placed with a distinct marker; it is not on the IUCN scale and is never ranked with it.
matrix.cell_colour_rule: A public cell takes the first type in cell_colour_precedence among the species recorded there. High-MCUI types come first so a conservation-priority species is never hidden (precautionary approach); among high-MCUI types the more restrictive use comes first; among low-MCUI types the one with high-BBVI evidence comes first. A cell with more than one type is marked mixed and lists the count per type. Cells without a typed species stay 'held' (grey).
matrix.map_meaning: 출현 기록이 있는 셀 × 종 유형. 해역의 자원량·분포·해역 점수가 아님.
